items.title: Short term effectiveness of dry needling and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization in knee osteoarthritis patients - a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 34 knee osteoarthritis patients found dry needling (DN) superior to instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) and conventional treatment (CT) in improving pain, function, and ROM at 4 and 6 weeks, with IASTM also outperforming CT for pain and function. All interventions showed comparable effects on muscle strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，对于膝骨关节炎，干针在缓解疼痛、改善功能和 ROM 上优于 IASTM 和常规治疗。但干针和 IASTM 的样本量都偏小，在将它们推为主线方案前，你需要更高质量的证据。
items.titleZh: 干针与器械辅助软组织松动术对膝骨关节炎患者短期疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 34 例膝骨关节炎患者的随机对照试验发现，干针在第 4 周和第 6 周改善疼痛、功能和关节活动度方面优于器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）和常规治疗，IASTM 在疼痛和功能改善方面也优于常规治疗。所有干预措施对膝关节肌肉力量的影响相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small RCT suggests dry needling is superior to IASTM and conventional treatment for pain, function, and ROM in knee OA. However, with limited sample sizes for both DN and IASTM, higher-quality evidence is needed before integrating them as primary interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小 (n=34)，仅限于短期效果评估 (6周随访)。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=34) and limited follow-up (6 weeks) for assessing short-term effects.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Physical Performance and Central Nervous System–Active Analgesics Independently Predict 8-Year Fall Risk in Adults with or at Risk for Knee Osteoarthritis
items.summary: Physical performance and the use of central nervous system-active analgesics were identified as independent predictors of 8-year fall risk in adults with or at risk for knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，身体表现不佳和使用中枢神经系统作用的镇痛药是膝骨关节炎患者 8 年内跌倒风险的独立预测因素。这意味着在评估膝骨关节炎患者时，除了关注关节本身，也要筛查这些风险因素，这有助于早期识别高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 身体表现和中枢神经系统活性镇痛药独立预测膝骨关节炎成人 8 年跌倒风险
items.summaryZh: 研究发现，身体表现和使用中枢神经系统活性镇痛药是膝骨关节炎成人或高危成人 8 年内跌倒风险的独立预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that poor physical performance and the use of CNS-active analgesics independently predict an 8-year fall risk in knee OA patients. This means you should screen for these risk factors when assessing knee OA patients, aiding early identification of high-risk individuals.
items.limitation: 文章摘要未提供足够信息来评估具体研究设计局限性，需阅读全文。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide sufficient information to assess specific study design limitations; full text review is required.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Prediction model for timing of independent walking on varied surface conditions in patients with early subacute stroke: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter prospective observational study developed and internally validated a Cox proportional hazards model to predict the timing of independent walking (FAC 5) on varied surfaces in 168 early subacute stroke patients, achieving a plateau cumulative rate of 51% by week 20, with AUC values of 0.86-0.92.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在早期亚急性卒中患者中，有模型能预测20周内独立行走的达到时机，预测准确性AUC可达0.86-0.92。你可以参考这个51%的累计速率来管理患者预期，但切记，该模型仅为内部验证，外部验证完成前，请勿直接用它来指导临床决策。
items.titleZh: 早期亚急性卒中患者在不同路面条件下独立行走时机预测模型：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心前瞻性观察研究开发并内部验证了一个 Cox 比例风险模型，用于预测 168 名早期亚急性卒中患者在多种路面条件下达到独立行走（FAC 5）的时机，累积实现率在第 20 周达到 51% 的平台期，模型 AUC 值介于 0.86-0.92。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that for early subacute stroke patients, a model can predict the timing of achieving independent walking within 20 weeks, with an AUC of 0.86-0.92. You can use the 51% cumulative rate to manage patient expectations, but remember, this model is only internally validated. Do not use it directly for clinical decision-making until external validation is complete.
items.limitation: 该模型仅进行了内部验证，需要在不同人群和临床环境下进行外部验证，以确认其泛化能力和稳定性。
items.limitationEn: The model was only internally validated and requires external validation across different populations and clinical settings to confirm its generalizability and robustness.

items.title: Calf Injuries: An Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport.
items.summary: A review highlights that anatomical characterization of calf muscle injuries, including gastrocnemius-soleus, is useful for understanding heterogeneity, but clinical management and return-to-sport decisions should prioritize progressive, criteria-based loading over isolated imaging findings.
items.curatedReason: 对于小腿肌肉损伤，解剖学定位确实能帮助我们理解损伤的异质性，但别因此就过度依赖影像结果。更重要的是，重返运动应严格遵循渐进式、基于功能表现的负荷标准，而非单一的影像学发现。
items.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学的方法诊断、管理和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 一份综述指出，小腿肌肉（包括腓肠肌和比目鱼肌）损伤的解剖学特征有助于理解其异质性，但临床管理和重返运动决策应优先考虑渐进的、基于标准的负荷，而非孤立的影像学发现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Anatomical characterization of calf muscle injuries is helpful for understanding their heterogeneity, but don't over-rely on imaging findings. Return-to-sport decisions should prioritize progressive, criteria-based loading over isolated imaging results.
items.limitation: 目前关于特定解剖模式与预后及重返运动结果之间关联的证据有限且多为观察性。
items.limitationEn: Evidence linking specific anatomical patterns to prognosis and return-to-sport outcomes remains limited and largely observational.

items.title: Low-Level Laser Therapy Versus Mirror Therapy for Post-Stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I: A Randomised Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=44) found that low-level laser therapy (LLLT) demonstrated an early between-group advantage over mirror therapy (MT) at 4 weeks in pain reduction (P adj = 0.039) and sensorimotor recovery (P adj = 0.022) in post-stroke CRPS-I; however, no significant difference was observed between groups at 8 and 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，对于卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 (CRPS-I)，低能量激光治疗 (LLLT) 在早期疼痛和感觉运动恢复方面可能优于镜像疗法 (MT)。但在 8-12 周的长期随访中，两种干预的效果差异不大，别把 LLLT 捧成唯一解。
items.titleZh: 低能量激光疗法与镜像疗法治疗卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 I 型：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验 (n=44) 发现，在卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 (CRPS-I) 患者中，低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 在 4 周时对疼痛减轻 (P adj = 0.039) 和感觉运动恢复 (P adj = 0.022) 方面优于镜像疗法 (MT)；但在 8 周和 12 周的随访中，两组间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that low-level laser therapy (LLLT) may offer an early advantage over mirror therapy (MT) for pain reduction and sensorimotor recovery in post-stroke CRPS-I. However, in the long run (8-12 weeks), both interventions achieved comparable outcomes. Do not overstate LLLT as the sole solution.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小 (n=44)，且随访时间最长为 12 周，限制了长期疗效的评估。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (n=44) and a maximum follow-up of 12 weeks, limiting the assessment of long-term efficacy.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: CPG | Interventions for the Management of Acute and Chronic Low Back Pain: Revision 2021
items.summary: The APTA Academy of Orthopaedic Physical Therapy published a 2021 revision of its clinical practice guideline for the management of acute and chronic low back pain, providing updated recommendations for physical therapy interventions, including specific considerations for older adults and postoperative patients.
items.curatedReason: 这是 APTA 骨科物理治疗学院 2021 年发布的腰痛管理临床实践指南更新。此指南为物理治疗师提供了关于急慢性腰痛干预的循证建议，尤其关注老年患者、伴腿痛的腰痛以及术后腰痛。你可以此作为日常临床决策的权威参考，确保你的腰痛管理实践符合最新证据。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南 | 急慢性腰痛干预措施：2021 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会骨科物理治疗学院发布了 2021 年版急慢性腰痛管理临床实践指南修订版，为物理治疗干预措施提供了更新建议，特别涵盖了老年患者和术后患者的考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is the 2021 update to the APTA Academy of Orthopaedic Physical Therapy's clinical practice guideline for low back pain management. It offers evidence-based recommendations on interventions for acute and chronic LBP, with a focus on older adults, LBP with leg pain, and postoperative LBP. You can use this as an authoritative reference for daily clinical decisions, ensuring your LBP management aligns with the latest evidence.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation combined with blood flow restriction training on lower-leg neuromuscular function in individuals with chronic ankle instability: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An assessor-blinded RCT (n=60) found that adding NMES and BFRT to an 8-week exercise program improved FAAM-Sports scores more than exercise alone or NMES alone in chronic ankle instability. The combined intervention also showed broader benefits in PL activation amplitude and EV strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，在标准运动方案基础上联合神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）和血流限制训练（BFRT），能更广泛地改善慢性踝关节不稳患者的胫骨前肌、腓骨长肌激活和外翻力量。对踝关节不稳患者，你可以在常规运动处方中考虑这种联合干预，以期获得更全面的短期收益。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激联合血流限制训练对慢性踝关节不稳患者下肢神经肌肉功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 60 名慢性踝关节不稳患者的随机对照试验发现，在 8 周运动计划中加入神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）和血流限制训练（BFRT），相比单独运动或单独 NMES，能更显著改善 FAAM-Sports 评分。联合干预还在腓骨长肌激活幅度和外翻力量方面显示出更广泛的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that combining neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and blood flow restriction training (BFRT) with a standard exercise program more broadly improved tibialis anterior and peroneus longus activation and eversion strength in chronic ankle instability patients. For CAI patients, you can consider this combined intervention in your regular exercise prescription for more comprehensive short-term benefits.
items.limitation: 研究的随访期为 8 周，长期疗效尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was 8 weeks, so long-term efficacy remains unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Machine learning-based identification of a minimal wearable sensor for gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma
items.summary: A machine learning study (n=32 VS patients, n=32 controls) found that a wrist-worn sensor during eyes-closed gait (FGA8) provided optimal discrimination (60-83% accuracy) for objective gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma, offering a continuous kinematic score for longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本观察研究提示，对前庭神经鞘瘤患者，腕部传感器结合闭眼步态任务可提供 60-83% 准确率的客观步态评估。这可能为前庭功能障碍患者的数字生物标志物和远程康复监测提供一个更简便的方案，但仍需 RCT 验证其临床效用。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习识别前庭神经鞘瘤步态评估的最小可穿戴传感器
items.summaryZh: 一项机器学习研究（32 名前庭神经鞘瘤患者 vs 32 名对照）发现，在闭眼步态任务（FGA8）中使用腕部传感器，能以 60-83% 的准确率优化前庭神经鞘瘤患者的客观步态评估，并提供连续运动学评分用于长期监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small observational study suggests that a wrist-worn sensor during eyes-closed gait can provide 60-83% accuracy for objective gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma patients. This may offer a simpler digital biomarker and remote monitoring solution for vestibular dysfunction, though RCTs are needed to validate its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（32 名患者 vs 32 名对照），模型在更大、更多样化人群中的泛化能力尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small (32 patients vs 32 controls), and the model's generalizability to larger, more diverse populations needs further validation.

items.title: Low levels of physical activity and high amount of sedentary behavior in the acute phase after stroke.
items.summary: A study (n=95) found that acute stroke patients had low physical activity (steps/day increased from 2844 to 4970 post-discharge) and high sedentary behavior (decreased from 22.7 to 21.1 hours/day post-discharge), with stroke severity inversely associated with steps per day.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了卒中急性期患者身体活动水平极低，即使出院后略有增加，久坐时间仍很长。这提示你，在卒中急性期和亚急性期的康复方案中，应更积极地促进身体活动和减少久坐，尤其对病情较重的患者。
items.titleZh: 卒中急性期患者身体活动水平低，久坐行为多
items.summaryZh: 一项对 95 名卒中患者的研究发现，其急性期身体活动水平较低（出院后步数从 2844 增至 4970 步/天），久坐行为较多（出院后从 22.7 减至 21.1 小时/天），且卒中严重程度与步数呈负相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights extremely low physical activity levels in acute stroke patients, with high sedentary time persisting even after slight increases post-discharge. This suggests you should more proactively promote physical activity and reduce sedentary behavior in acute and subacute stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially for patients with more severe stroke.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，且样本量为 95 人，存在患者依从性和通用性限制。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study with a sample size of 95, limited by patient compliance and generalizability.

items.title: Client Challenge
items.summary: A systematic review identified 22 recent clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) for low back pain management, finding heterogeneity in recommendations but common agreement on NSAIDs, therapeutic exercise, staying active, and spinal manipulation for acute LBP.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述提醒我们，尽管全球 22 份腰痛 CPG 存在异质性，但针对急性腰痛，NSAIDs、治疗性运动、保持活动和脊柱手法治疗是普遍共识。在实践中，你应该优先考虑这些在多数高质量指南中达成一致的核心干预措施。
items.titleZh: 近期腰痛管理临床实践指南：一项全球比较
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述收集了 22 份近期腰痛管理临床实践指南，发现各指南的推荐存在异质性，但对急性腰痛普遍推荐非甾体抗炎药、治疗性运动、保持活动和脊柱手法治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that while 22 global LBP CPGs show heterogeneity, NSAIDs, therapeutic exercise, staying active, and spinal manipulation are common recommendations for acute LBP. In practice, you should prioritize these core interventions consistently endorsed by most high-quality guidelines.
items.limitation: 纳入的 CPGs 推荐存在显著异质性，且部分建议缺乏明确性，限制了直接的临床应用。
items.limitationEn: The included CPGs showed significant heterogeneity in recommendations, and some advice lacked clarity, limiting direct clinical application.

items.title: Why Revenue Cycle Operations Are Ready for Change
items.summary: WebPT discusses how technology is poised to transform revenue cycle operations in rehab therapy, automating complex claims and payment processes to improve efficiency.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的述评指出，康复治疗机构需要关注技术对营收周期管理（RCM）的变革性影响，自动化有望显著提升理赔和支付效率。作为经营者，你应开始评估这些技术如何简化复杂的报销规则和行政工作，为诊所未来的运营效率提升做准备。
items.titleZh: 为什么收入周期运营已为变革做好准备
items.summaryZh: WebPT 探讨了技术如何重塑康复治疗的收入周期运营，通过自动化复杂理赔和支付流程来提高效率。
items.curatedReasonEn: WebPT's commentary emphasizes that rehab practices should note technology's transformative impact on revenue cycle management (RCM), with automation promising significant gains in claims and payment efficiency. As a practitioner, you should start evaluating how these technologies can streamline complex reimbursement rules and administrative tasks, preparing your clinic for future operational improvements.

items.title: Finding the rhythm
items.summary: The annual Norwegian Sports and Exercise Medicine Society issue of BJSM focuses on timing across daily, seasonal, and lifespan scales, featuring papers on sleep health in sport and the distinct associations of stepping intensity and daily volume with all-cause and cardiovascular mortality.
items.curatedReason: 这份特刊强调了运动医学中时间因素的重要性，从日常的睡眠健康到运动强度与心血管死亡率的关联，这些洞察能让你更全面地考量患者的训练和康复方案。
items.titleZh: 寻找节奏：挪威运动与锻炼医学学会特刊聚焦运动计时
items.summaryZh: 《英国运动医学杂志》挪威运动与锻炼医学学会特刊聚焦运动中的时间因素，涵盖每日睡眠健康、季节性训练和终身运动表现，并指出步频强度和每日步数与全因及心血管死亡率有不同的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This special issue emphasizes the importance of timing in sports medicine, from daily sleep health to the association between exercise intensity and cardiovascular mortality. These insights can help you more holistically consider your patients' training and rehabilitation programs.

items.title: Supportive Strides: Co-designing Community-Based Walking Programs with Embedded Socialisation and Peer Support for People after Stroke
items.summary: The "Supportive Strides" community-based walking program was co-designed with stroke survivors, carers, and health professionals using an Integrated Knowledge Translation approach to enhance physical activity and social connection post-stroke. Key principles included social support, inclusive environments, and motivational elements, resulting in a program ready for testing.
items.curatedReason: 这份步行计划为卒中幸存者提供了基于社区的活动方案，强调社会支持和共融环境。如果你正在设计类似项目，请务必关注其中"共同设计"的理念，这可能提升患者的参与度和依从性。
items.titleZh: 支持性步伐：与卒中患者共同设计结合社交和同伴支持的社区步行计划
items.summaryZh: “支持性步伐”社区步行计划通过综合知识转化方法与卒中幸存者、照护者及专业人士共同设计，旨在提高卒中后的身体活动和社会连接。该计划整合了社会支持、包容环境和激励元素，已准备进行测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: This walking program for stroke survivors emphasizes social support and inclusive environments within a community setting. If you're designing similar programs, prioritize the "co-design" approach as highlighted here; it likely improves patient engagement and adherence.
items.limitation: 这是一项共同设计研究，而非干预效果的评估，因此尚无直接临床疗效数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a co-design study, not an evaluation of intervention effectiveness, thus direct clinical outcome data are not yet available.

items.title: Effects of TENS, NMES, and Combination Therapy on Hemiplegic Shoulder Pain and Function After Stroke.
items.summary: A randomized study (n=60) found that combined TENS+NMES significantly reduced hemiplegic shoulder pain and SPADI scores compared to TENS alone in acute/subacute stroke patients, but did not improve upper extremity motor function, spasticity, or ADL.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中后偏瘫肩痛患者，联合使用 TENS 和 NMES 可能比单独使用 TENS 更能改善疼痛和肩关节功能。但它对上肢运动功能、痉挛或 ADL 的改善不显著，不要过度解读其效用。
items.titleZh: TENS、NMES 及其联合疗法对卒中后偏瘫肩痛和功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项随机研究（n=60）发现，在急性/亚急性卒中患者中，联合 TENS+NMES 组比单独 TENS 组能显著减轻偏瘫肩痛和 SPADI 评分，但对上肢运动功能、痉挛或日常生活活动能力没有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with hemiplegic shoulder pain after stroke, combined TENS and NMES may improve pain and shoulder function more than TENS alone. However, it did not significantly improve upper extremity motor function, spasticity, or ADL, so do not overinterpret its efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且无法计算常规的响应率，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, and a conventional response rate could not be calculated, which may affect the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Associations of Patient-Reported and Objective Measures of Mobility With Prospective Falls in Older Adults with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: This study evaluated the associations of patient-reported (PDDS) and objective (SPPB) measures of mobility with prospective falls in older adults with multiple sclerosis, finding both measures to be relevant for fall risk assessment.
items.curatedReason: 对于多发性硬化症老年患者的跌倒风险评估，患者自报的 PDDS 量表与客观的 SPPB 量表都与未来跌倒相关。临床上应将这两种评估方法结合使用，以更全面地识别跌倒高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症老年患者的患者自报与客观活动度测量与前瞻性跌倒的关联
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了多发性硬化症老年患者的患者自报（PDDS）和客观（SPPB）活动度测量与前瞻性跌倒的关联，发现这两种测量方法都与跌倒风险评估相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For fall risk assessment in older adults with multiple sclerosis, both the patient-reported PDDS scale and the objective SPPB scale are associated with prospective falls. Clinically, these two assessment methods should be used in combination to more comprehensively identify high-risk patients for falls.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性，无法确立因果关系，且研究人群仅限于多发性硬化症老年患者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study is observational, precluding the establishment of causality, and the study population is limited to older adults with multiple sclerosis, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Recovery Trajectories of Lower Limb Motor Function After Cervical Spinal Cord Injury: A Latent Class Mixed Model Analysis
items.summary: A latent class mixed model analysis examined the recovery trajectories of lower limb motor function following cervical spinal cord injury, aiming to understand functional changes for rehabilitation planning.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，颈椎脊髓损伤后下肢功能恢复可能存在不同的轨迹，但具体到临床应用，我们仍需更多高质量证据来指导个性化康复路径的设计。目前，这更多是为我们理解恢复模式提供了一个新视角，而非直接的干预指南。
items.titleZh: 颈椎脊髓损伤后下肢运动功能的恢复轨迹：一项潜在类别混合模型分析
items.summaryZh: 一项潜在类别混合模型分析研究了颈椎脊髓损伤后下肢运动功能的恢复轨迹，旨在了解功能变化以辅助康复计划的制定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that distinct lower limb motor function recovery trajectories may exist post-cervical spinal cord injury. However, for direct clinical application, we still need more high-quality evidence to guide personalized rehabilitation path design. For now, this offers a new perspective on understanding recovery patterns, rather than immediate intervention guidelines.
items.limitation: 研究的细节（如样本量、随访期、具体干预措施）在摘要中未明确给出，限制了对其结果强度和适用性的判断。
items.limitationEn: Details of the study, such as sample size, follow-up period, and specific interventions, are not clearly provided in the abstract, limiting the assessment of its strength and applicability.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Vestibular rehabilitation therapy in Turkey: insights into physical therapists' clinical practice.
items.summary: A survey of 178 physical therapists in Turkey found that 88.8% had no VRT experience, with low reported usage of key maneuvers and exercises, indicating significant educational and implementation gaps in vestibular rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项土耳其的调查揭示了当地物理治疗师在前庭康复治疗（VRT）方面的知识和实践差距。这提示我们，即使是成熟的干预手段，在全球范围内的临床应用普及度和教育培训水平也可能存在显著差异。
items.titleZh: 土耳其前庭康复治疗：物理治疗师临床实践洞察
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 178 名物理治疗师的调查发现，88.8% 的受访者没有前庭康复治疗（VRT）经验，关键手法和练习的使用率很低，表明前庭康复领域存在显著的教育和实施差距。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey from Turkey reveals significant knowledge and practice gaps among local physical therapists in Vestibular Rehabilitation Therapy (VRT). This highlights that even for established interventions, the global penetration of clinical application and educational training levels can vary substantially.
items.limitation: 该调查采用开放式网络问卷形式，无法确定确切的回复率，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The survey used an open online questionnaire, making it impossible to determine the exact response rate and potentially introducing selection bias.

items.title: Movement matters: the path to professional impact.
items.summary: Christopher M. Powers, PT, PhD, FAPTA, has been selected as the 57th McMillan Lecturer, recognized for his extensive contributions to human movement science, lower-extremity biomechanics, and musculoskeletal injury research, with over 230 peer-reviewed publications and significant leadership roles within the APTA.
items.curatedReason: 这条新闻是 APTA 颁发 McMillan 讲座的新闻稿，主要在表彰一位杰出物理治疗师的职业成就和研究贡献，没有新的研究发现或临床实践改变。
items.titleZh: 运动至关重要：通往专业影响力之路
items.summaryZh: Christopher M. Powers 博士被选为第 57 届 McMillan 讲座主讲人，以表彰他在人体运动科学、下肢生物力学和肌肉骨骼损伤研究方面的广泛贡献，他拥有超过 230 篇同行评审出版物，并在 APTA 内部担任重要领导职务。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news is a press release about the APTA McMillan Lecture, primarily honoring a distinguished physical therapist's career achievements and research contributions, with no new research findings or changes to clinical practice.

items.title: When evidence fails in real life: Rethinking sports injury rehabilitation and prevention.
items.summary: This perspective critically examines traditional linear, reductionist approaches to sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, advocating for an integrated, complexity-informed framework that redefines evidence-based practice and the biopsychosocial model to support patient-centered and contextually relevant physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论挑战了运动损伤康复和预防中传统线性、还原论的思维模式。它提醒你，循证实践并非只是研究设计层级，更应结合临床专业知识和患者价值，以复杂性科学和动态生物心理社会模型来指导更个性化的干预。
items.titleZh: 当证据在现实中失效：反思运动损伤康复与预防
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章批判性地审视了运动损伤预防和康复中传统的线性、还原论方法，倡导采用整合的、复杂性知情框架，重新定义循证实践和生物心理社会模型，以支持以患者为中心、与情境相关的物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary challenges traditional linear, reductionist thinking in sports injury rehabilitation and prevention. It reminds you that evidence-based practice is not merely a hierarchy of study designs, but should integrate clinical expertise and patient values, using complexity science and a dynamic biopsychosocial model to guide more personalized interventions.

items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A 6-week randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy for adhesive capsulitis resulted in statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM. However, only shoulder abduction (14.08°) showed potential for clinical meaningfulness, as other outcomes did not meet MCID thresholds.
items.curatedReason: 虽然神经松动术与 PNF 联合治疗冻结肩在统计学上改善了疼痛和 ROM，但多数效应量未达临床最小重要差异 (MCID)，仅肩外展有潜力。将神经松动术作为辅助手段时，应关注活动度而非作为疼痛或功能障碍的主要干预。
items.titleZh: 神经松动术联合本体感觉神经肌肉促进技术在冻结肩患者中的附加价值：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 6 周的随机对照试验（n=56）发现，神经松动术 (NMTs) 联合本体感觉神经肌肉促进术 (PNF) 和常规物理治疗，能显著改善冻结肩患者的短期疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度。但多数效应量未达临床最小重要差异 (MCID)，仅肩外展 (14.08°) 显示出潜在的临床意义。
items.curatedReasonEn: While neural mobilization combined with PNF for adhesive capsulitis statistically improved pain and ROM, most effect sizes did not meet the minimal clinically important difference (MCID); only shoulder abduction showed potential for clinical meaning. When considering neural mobilization as an adjunct, focus on range of motion rather than using it as a primary intervention for pain or disability.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（56 例），随访时间短（6 周），且大多数疼痛和功能障碍指标的组间差异未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (56 patients) and short follow-up (6 weeks), with most between-group differences in pain and disability outcomes not reaching the minimal clinically important difference (MCID).
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Cross-cultural adaptation and validation of the Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS) into Arabic among stroke survivors in Saudi Arabia.
items.summary: This cross-sectional psychometric study (n=130) validated the Arabic version of the Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS-Ar) for stroke survivors, demonstrating excellent internal consistency (Cronbach's α = 0.87-0.97) and test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.78-0.94), with strong correlations to established functional and quality-of-life measures.
items.curatedReason: SF-SIS-Ar 是一个可靠且有效的卒中评估工具，扩展了卒中康复在阿拉伯语人群中的评估手段。如果你在阿拉伯语国家执业或有阿拉伯语患者，这是你评估卒中患者生活质量和功能影响的重要工具。
items.titleZh: Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS) 阿拉伯语版本的跨文化适应与验证
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面心理测量学研究（n=130）验证了 Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS) 的阿拉伯语版本 (SF-SIS-Ar)，显示出卓越的内部一致性 (Cronbach's α = 0.87-0.97) 和重测信度 (ICC = 0.78-0.94)，并与已有的功能和生活质量评估工具高度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SF-SIS-Ar is a reliable and valid stroke assessment tool, expanding evaluation options for stroke rehabilitation in Arabic-speaking populations. If you practice in Arabic-speaking countries or have Arabic-speaking patients, this is an important tool for assessing stroke survivors' quality of life and functional impact.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法评估工具对干预效果的敏感性或长期稳定性。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, so it cannot evaluate the tool's sensitivity to intervention effects or long-term stability.

items.title: [The Lancet Commissions] The NUS–Lancet PRIME Commission: transforming pandemic readiness for equity
items.summary: The NUS–Lancet PRIME Commission redefines pandemic readiness, offering a practical blueprint for whole-of-society pandemic planning and implementation, integrating evidence from 20 countries, future scenarios, and epidemiological modeling to move towards people-centered protection.
items.curatedReason: 这份委员会报告为全社会层面的大流行病准备和实施提供了实用蓝图，强调了以人为本的保护。作为物理治疗师，它提醒你未来在大流行病应对中，不仅要关注临床治疗，还要考虑如何在机构和社区层面更有效地贡献和整合服务。
items.titleZh: NUS–《柳叶刀》PRIME 委员会报告：为公平而转型大流行病准备工作
items.summaryZh: 新加坡国立大学 (NUS) –《柳叶刀》PRIME 委员会报告重新定义了大流行病准备工作，为全社会大流行病规划和实施提供了实用蓝图。该报告整合了来自 20 个国家的证据、未来情景和流行病学模型，旨在推动以人为本的保护。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commission report provides a practical blueprint for whole-of-society pandemic preparedness and implementation, emphasizing people-centered protection. As a physical therapist, it reminds you that in future pandemic responses, you need to consider not only clinical treatment but also how to more effectively contribute and integrate services at institutional and community levels.

items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (n=1536) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) in people with stroke, with balance training and cognitive components being most effective, particularly for those in the chronic stage with mild to moderate disability.
items.curatedReason: 这份高质量系统综述和 meta 分析明确指出，卒中患者的跌倒次数可通过运动显著减少39%。在治疗方案中优先纳入平衡训练和认知成分。对处于慢性期、轻中度功能障碍的患者，这套方案的疗效尤其显著，临床上应立即采纳。
items.titleZh: 体育锻炼能减少卒中患者跌倒相关结局：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 18 项 RCT（n=1536）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，体育锻炼能显著减少卒中患者跌倒次数 39%（IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]），其中平衡训练和认知成分的方案效果最佳，尤其适用于慢性期且轻中度功能障碍的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis definitively shows exercise can reduce falls by 39% in stroke patients. Prioritize balance training and cognitive components in your intervention designs. This approach is particularly effective for those in the chronic stage with mild-to-moderate disability, and you should implement it now.
items.limitation: 子组分析为探索性质，结果需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: Subgroup analyses were exploratory, and results require further validation.

items.title: Effects of Using High-Frequency TENS During an Exercise Therapy Program in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled trial (n=96) found that adding high-frequency transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) to an exercise therapy program provided no additional benefit over sham stimulation for knee osteoarthritis, with an adjusted mean difference of 1.05 points (95% CI, -5.19 to 7.29) on the KOOS Pain subscale post-intervention.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 研究显示，对于膝骨关节炎患者，在高频 TENS 之外叠加运动疗法并无额外益处。在评估膝骨关节炎的干预方案时，应优先考虑有更强证据支持的疗法。
items.titleZh: 高频 TENS 在膝骨关节炎运动疗法中的效果：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=96）发现，在膝骨关节炎患者的运动疗法中加入高频经皮电神经刺激（TENS）并未比假刺激带来额外益处，干预后 KOOS 疼痛分量表的调整平均差异为 1.05 分（95% CI, -5.19 to 7.29）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that adding high-frequency TENS to exercise therapy offers no additional benefit for knee osteoarthritis patients. When evaluating interventions for knee osteoarthritis, prioritize therapies with stronger evidence.
items.limitation: 研究未进行正式的盲法评估，随访期短，且缺乏单纯运动组作为对照。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked formal blinding assessment, had a short follow-up, and did not include an exercise-only group for comparison.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy
